slides.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea: a war of words
slides.body: What each side said this week

slides.title: Ethiopia's PM
slides.body: “Massawa has been emptied, while Assab has been reduced to a ghost town,” Abiy Ahmed said of Eritrea's ports, Fana reported on Oct 19.

slides.title: Eritrea's state media
slides.body: A paper on state-run Shabait (Oct 20) called Ethiopia's push for sea access an expansionist project that threatens Eritrea's sovereignty.

slides.title: “No crisis” vs “destructive role”
slides.body: Eritrea's UN envoy told US diplomats there is no “crisis” with Ethiopia. Ethiopian official Getachew Reda told the UN Horn envoy Eritrea plays a “destructive role.”

slides.title: Lower the temperature. Talk, don't fight.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
